task_clarification: For n>0 and x in R^n, let y=log(sum_i exp(x_i)) and g_j=exp(x_j-y). Compute yHat by unshifted Algorithm 3.1: relative-error exponential evaluations, recursive floating-point summation, and a final rounded logarithm.

For each j, evaluate the alternative division-free softmax formula by one rounded subtraction x_j-yHat and a relative-error exponential evaluation. Do not replace it with the basic exp(x_j)/sum_i exp(x_i) algorithm.

Formalize Theorem 3.4: ||gHat-g||_infinity/||g||_infinity <= (|y|+max_j |x_j-y|+n+2)*u+O(u^2). Interpret the O(u^2) remainder uniformly at fixed n,x over all admissible local errors, with an explicit C and positive radius independent of execution.
scope_constraints: Keep the full x domain and n>0; ||g||_infinity is positive.
Represent every operation in the alternative execution and the absence of overflow/underflow through the source's relative-error model.
No premise may assume the desired relative output bound; no target-result declaration may be imported from NumStability.
